private.title: Private event — approval required
private.intro: This event charges on approval. Here is how it works:
private.step1: When you send your request, your bank authorises the charge. It may show up in your banking app or statement as a normal purchase (not as “pending”) — this is expected, not an error.
private.step2: The venue reviews your request (up to 48 h).
private.step3: If they accept: the charge is confirmed and you get your tickets with a QR by email.
private.step4: If they decline, or 48 h pass: the charge is reversed. Depending on your bank it may take a few business days to show up — this is normal for card reversals.
private.foot: We will email you at every step.
private.noticeBody: When you send your request your bank authorises the charge. If the venue accepts it is confirmed; if they decline or 48 h pass, it is reversed.
private.consent: I understand that sending this request will place a charge on my card, which may appear as a normal purchase (not as “pending”) in my bank. If my request is declined or gets no answer within 48 h, it will be reversed, which may take several business days to show up.
private.leadShort: This event is confirmed once the venue approves your request. When you send it, your bank authorises the amount and it may appear as a normal purchase (not as “pending”).
private.consentShort: I understand that sending my request will authorise a charge on my card —which may appear as a normal purchase in my bank— under the %TERMS% of the private event.
